notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
We've got a new patch for you folks! But first, a quick announcement on our company name.

Rocket Hammer has now changed its name to Brimstone. Over the past few months we've been making some changes to the company. We have new team members, new projects, and a new direction for the company. So we felt a change of name was needed to fit this new change and direction!

Now on to the patch notes!

Patch 1.0.3
Updated lighting on all levels for better visibility.
Updated waterfall particle systems for better performance.
Added "loading spinner" during level loading.
Fixed keyboard being unresponsive on the rule select screen.
Fixed keyboard join icon not resetting when a keyboard player leaves.

notes.title: The Game Is Released!
notes.content:
https://thumbs.gfycat.com/RecentSkinnyKinglet-size_restricted.gif
Lance A Lot: Enhanced Edition Launched!

That's right folks! Go home, take your wallet, spend that hard earned cash on some pizza, some sort of fizzy drink that is probably not good enough for you but you drink it anyway because why not, you're totally worth it, and grab Lance A Lot: Enhanced Edition! 

The wait was long. Game Devs have fallen on the floor after programs crashed over and over again. Someone lost their chair. I think it's on the roof. Rockets were launched and arrests were made because you're not really supposed to launch government owned missiles without proper clearance. 
So what are you doing! Treat yourself! To some lancing against your friend! Scream at them! Teach them who's the best in a duel to the very end! It's a crazy game that makes no sense but gosh dangit those explosions sure are great!

Oh, wait, what? It’s also on sale right now! That means you can add a bunch more stuff to your pizza and still get the game!

But wait yet again! If you’ve already purchased Lance A Lot: Classic Edition, you will find the Enhanced Edition already within your steam library! Nice.

notes.title: Release Postponed to September 28th
notes.content:
https://thumbs.gfycat.com/CircularEthicalAmericanblackvulture-size_restricted.gif
Release Date Pushed to September 28th
Hey folks! We'll be pushing back the release of Lance A Lot: Enhanced Edition to September 28th! That's just a short two day delay. 

So why delay? There's a bit more polish that needs to happen. You know the, fireplaces that decided they wanted to be floating in midair, fireflies becoming killer insects of dread, your boss being better at you than the game so you need to tweak some things so you'll stop coming in last place and having to buy the company pizza. 

You know. The small things. 

So hey! If you've purchased the Classic Edition, duel a few friends in the meantime. Or, if you're really serious, I suggest contacting NASA and getting your hands on some REAL rockets. Put on some plate armor and joust the way you've always dreamed of jousting! Or just wait until September 28th. Your choice, not ours. 

New Map: Floating Isles
Because two portals aren't enough.

Try firing your lance into the horizontal and diagonal portals, and then instantly regret your decision while the lances loop around until they skewer you on accident, because you totally meant to do that. Really. You meant to do that.

https://i.imgur.com/jAiyQJm.jpg

notes.title: Announcing Lance A Lot: Enhanced Edition!
notes.content:
]
Announcing Lance A Lot: Enhanced Edition
September 26th we will be releasing the Enhanced Edition of Lance A Lot! 

The Enhanced version features a major overhaul of the visuals, gameplay and levels of the original we released last year - and will be available for free for all owners of the Classic version (it will be added automatically to your Steam library upon release). The Classic version will be made unavailable for purchase upon Enhanced Edition's release.

That being said, we still recommend new players to wait for the new Enhanced Edition as it features and additional content make for the best game play experience of Lance A Lot! 

Major Differences From Classic Edition
Complete graphics overhaul with 8 brand new maps, redesigned UI, menus, player characters and a brand new knight - The Forest Guardian!
Fire your lance to skewer your opponents, or charge it for an explosive kill!
Rocket Hammers to bash your enemies, stunning them or knocking them out with a fully charged one hit kill!
AI system for solo play!
More content to interact with from smashable trees to rocket missiles.
For more information, check out our Steam Page or follow us on facebook!
